findings.title: Ambiguous prefix match
findings.body:
When several countries share the same dialing prefix (e.g. `+1` for US/CA, `+7` for RU/KZ), the stable sort returns whichever comes first in `countries`. In `PhoneField`, this inferred country also overrides `fallbackCountry`.

Example: a Canadian user with a prefilled `+1...` number would see the US flag, placeholder and template instead of their own region.

Fix: when `fallbackCountry` has the same prefix as the match, prefer `fallbackCountry`.

findings.title: Late country resolution
findings.body:
`defaultPhoneCountry` uses `fallbackCountry` until `countries` finishes loading. During that window, a prefilled number from another country (e.g. `+447...` with region PT) is shown as local digits `447...` under the `+351` prefix.

If the user edits the field before the countries load, `handleChangeText` emits `+351447...`, which corrupts the stored number.

This only happens while countries are still loading. Possible fixes:
- skip stripping or prefixing until `countries` is available, or
- keep the raw value unchanged when its prefix doesn't match `phoneCountry`.
